text: Program Objective It will provide non-native Chinese speakers with the Chinese knowledge and skills practice. The program objective is to cultivate the practical masterswho will speak fluent Chinese and be well equipped with Chinese cultures and the ability of intercultural communication in Chinese language. During their studying andtraining, students will improve their Chinese language abilities in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating. Students are able to speak Chinese, and understand some Chinese history and cultures. Main Course ComprehensiveChinese, Chinese Listening, Chinese Speaking, Chinese Reading and Writing, Practical Communication Skills, Practical Writing, Chinese News Broadcast, Chinese Newspapers and Periodicals Reading, Chinese Popular Culture. Duration 1 year Why study Chinese in Xinjiang University Xinjiang University is a member of the Central Asia International Council Center of Chinese Language, and has established two Confucianism Institutes in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan and Novosibirsk, Russia respectively.
